source: R-009, interpreted under owner handoff v2.2 SteamOS-first direction

hypotheses.description: Persistent Vitis AI sessions reduce per-frame overhead.
hypotheses.baseline: session creation excluded from steady-state CPU reference
hypotheses.falsification: persistent reuse produces no repeatable reduction in non-inference overhead
hypotheses.stop_go: GO by default; persistent session is baseline
hypotheses.hardware_dependency: Physical Ryzen AI Z2 Extreme/XDNA2; exact SteamOS/driver/firmware/runtime compatibility before activation. Host contracts are not performance proof.
